subject: monster stats
text: The guide compares only monster Experience and Gold values because those are the only stats that are easily verifiable.

evidence.quote: The only stats that are easily verifiable are Experience and Gold so I'm starting with those

subject: Slime
text: Slime is listed with 1 experience in all four experience columns.

subject: Slime
text: Slime is listed with a max gold of 2 in all three gold columns.
